title: Climbing Stairs
prompt: You are climbing a staircase with `n` steps. Each time you can climb either 1 or 2 steps. In how many distinct ways can you climb to the top?
hints: Notice the number of ways to reach step n is related to the ways to reach n-1 and n-2.
This is really the Fibonacci sequence in disguise.
You only need to track the last two values, not a full array — O(1) space.
